items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: We used to go to a place called Pop Monroe's, Pops Monroe. And he used to sell needle whiskey... we used to go there and play all night long.

ctx.x: Did you first meet Lester with Basie, or had you known him before?

No, I had met him before. We used to jam, go jamming up in Kansas City. We used to go to a place called Pop Monroe's, Pops Monroe. And he used to sell needle whiskey. They called it needle whiskey. It was corn, but it was cured by needles. And he had a pen up at his house, and we used to go there and play all night long. Several guys. I just can't remember all the guys that used to go. So we'd just go up there and take out a little... I think you could get a pitcher of whiskey for 20 cents, you know. And we'd go…
